title: Deep Fashion
description:
The Deep Fashion server is a regular server
The Deep Fashion server is a regular server with the possibility of ordinary survival.
The server has a clan system that will allow you to unite entire companies of like minded people
Build your city of like-mind
body:
Сервер Deep Fashion обычный сервер с плагинами на приват, кланами, блокировкой сундуков, печек, бочек и прочего, также с системой кланов.
The Deep Fashion server is a regular server with plugins for private play, clans, locking of chests, furnaces, barrels, and other items, as well as a clan system.
On our server, you can play vanilla survival with a clan system and voice chat, which saves you from writing a long text in the chat.
Find like-minded people and build your city.

Why should I log into your server?:
Responsive administration
If something is lost due to the server's fault, the administration will return the missing
It is strictly forbidden to list players on our server, so you don't have to worry about someone spoiling your building.
